decoDesc.text: A Techno-Protocol Electric Pylon furnished with a Xiranite receiving module. For electrical currents coursing between the relays, such modules serve as beacons in the darkness that accurately guide them towards their destination pylons with extremely low transmission loss.

desc.text: The Xiranite Pylon can auto-connect to the Protocol Automation-Core (PAC) and Xiranite Relays within 80 meters; and to Xiranite Pylons and other power facilities within 30 meters. When placed inside the Core AIC Area, it can auto-connect to the PAC regardless of distance. This pylon can be used to supply power to facilities within range and transmit power across short distances.

noObtainWayHint.text: Production: Requires Specified Basic AIC Plan Tech

desc.text: The Xiranite Pylon is a special facility of Wuling. Like an improved Electric Pylon, it can supply power to nearby facilities and provide short-range power transmission. The Xiranite Pylon <@gd.key>automatically connects</> to the Protocol Automation-Core (PAC) and any <@gd.key>Xiranite Relays</> within 80 meters, and to other <@gd.key>Xiranite Pylons</> and power facilities within 30 meters. When placed in the Core AIC Area, the Xiranite Pylon automatically connects to the <@gd.key>PAC</> <@gd.key>regardless of distance</>. It can supply power to facilities within range and transmit power across short distances.
